subject: [PATCH v8 18/30] mm/hmm: fault PMD swap entries on demand

2026-10-02.patch_summary: This patch modifies the handling of absent PMD entries in the Linux kernel's Heterogeneous Memory Management (HMM) module. When a swapped-out huge page is encountered, it will no longer be reported as an error, but instead treated like a PTE swap entry and recorded as such when a fault occurs. This change ensures that memory that needs to be paged in is properly identified and handled.
